title: NextWave is a UK/NL Appian boutique concentrated in finance and model risk management
content:
NextWave Consulting is a newly added row in the workbook: a boutique with UK and Netherlands presence whose Appian work sits in finance and model risk management. The tool column also records an Appian EMEA Innovation Award.

The record is deliberately thin. No capability gap has been researched for this lead, so there is no fit statement to make — only the placement: which platform, which domains, which geographies. Appian is a low-code platform, which puts the row in the same category as the Mendix and OutSystems leads in this corpus, where a platform already occupies the slot a record layer would fill.

What makes the row worth keeping is the domain. Model risk management is a field where decisions are reviewed after the fact, which is where an attributed record has obvious value — but that is a hypothesis to test, not a finding, and the workbook's own priority of 'decide thesis first' says as much.
